criteria.text: every ship (ferry, tug, boat) tracked with Pd >= 0.8 on multistatic_b (radiator tracks)
false tracks at most 2 per minute on every test recording
the wreck of the simple harbor found by its echo with Pd >= 0.9 on seeds 1 to 3 (echo tracks)
on frames where the moored hull, a UUV and a piling are all measured, the size indicator puts the hull below the piling in at least 70 % of them (multistatic recordings, tuning and multistatic_b)
